card.name: Small linking words in label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as on, of, for after a verb or noun in set label phrases, e.g. "based on", "age of", "stand for". Also fires on the first word inside cross-references such as "[see Use in" or "[see Dosing and".

modes.label: Based on severity
modes.description: The word on after based in instructions to interrupt or stop a drug.

modes.label: Linking word before a number or name
modes.description: Of or for after a noun or verb, ahead of an age, time or title.
modes.example: Allow the reconstituted solution to stand<< for>> 5 minutes.

modes.label: Cross-reference start
modes.description: The first word after "[see" pointing to a label section.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts of the next phrase and away from plural measurement words like averages, volumes and intervals.
card.plain: It marks small linking words like "on" or "of" in stock label phrases such as "based on severity" or "age of 18".
